test_title: PYST 26 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rewrite the following sentence from the passage in passive voice without changing the tense:

"The snake plant (Sansevieria trifasciata) can endure erratic watering schedules without forfeiting its structural elegance."

options.text: Erratic watering schedules can be endured by the snake plant without forfeiting its structural elegance.
Erratic watering schedules are endured by the snake plant without forfeiting its structural elegance.
Erratic watering schedules will be endured by the snake plant without forfeiting its structural elegance.
Erratic watering schedules were endured by the snake plant without forfeiting its structural elegance.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive Voice Transformation:** To convert a sentence with a modal verb (like **"can"**) into passive voice, the structure used is: *Object + Modal Verb + be + Past Participle of the main verb + by + Subject*.
 
• **Tense Consistency:** The original sentence uses the modal **"can,"** which indicates capability in the present. Option 1 maintains this tense by using **"can be endured"**.
 
• **Analysis of Incorrect Options:** 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Changes the modal "can" to the simple present "are," losing the sense of "capability."
 
• **Option 3:** Changes the tense to the future ("will be").
 
• **Option 4:** Changes the tense to the past ("were").
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indomitable:** Used to describe the snake plant, this word means impossible to subdue or defeat, highlighting its extreme resilience.
 
• **Erratic:** Refers to watering schedules that are not even or regular in pattern; unpredictable.
 
• **Snake Plant (Sansevieria):** Noted for its structural elegance, it is one of the "axiomatic" plants for urban dwellers with a "paucity of time".
